verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a Pika feature that applies one operation across many items at once, such as batch upscaling, batch captioning or multi-file processing. 'Unlimited parallel generations' is a plan's concurrency allowance, an adjacent capability rather than a bulk-operation feature. The API and MCP server are developer building blocks a user could script bulk work with, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
